title: Political Science - General Option
sourceText:
Equity and Justice [EQJS]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Humanities [HUM]

POL S 101 [SSCI]

Electives

Diversity [DIVR]

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

POL S 102

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Arts [ARTS]

Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

POL S 103

Foreign Language, if needed, or Electives
Two years of high school foreign language or at least two semesters of college-level foreign language are required by the College of Arts and Sciences for graduation.

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

POL S 201

Complete Writing Portfolio

POL S Electives
POL S Electives: 24 credits required.  Must include a minimum of 9 credits of 300-400 level coursework and 2 [M] courses.

Electives
Electives must include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 40 credits of upper-division coursework. May need to include a writing in the major [M] course to meet University requirements.

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

POL S Elective
POL S Electives: 24 credits required.  Must include a minimum of 9 credits of 300-400 level coursework and 2 [M] courses.

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

Complete the School’s Exit Survey for Political Science majors

A student may be admitted to the Political Science - General option upon making their intention known to the department.

36 credits in POL S are required, at least 15 of which must be earned at WSU.
